dedupe_keys.name: reds repository of distribution systems test cases

description: REDS, the REpository of Distribution Systems, is a collection of radial distribution test cases gathered by Rajesh Kavasseri and Cristinel Ababei to give researchers a common suite of realistic cases for power flow, network reconfiguration, capacitor placement, load balancing and contingency analysis. The page read on 2026-09-26 lists eight radial systems converted to a simple-to-parse format described in a readme, downloadable as one archive: Civanlar's 13-bus system, a 29-bus case known as the IEEE 30-bus system, Baran's 32-bus system, 83, 135 and 201-bus systems from published reconfiguration papers, and two hypothetical systems of 873 buses with 7 feeders and 10,476 buses with 84 feeders and 260 tie switches created by the NDSU Power Group. Each entry cites its source paper. Coverage is benchmark feeders, not a real territory. The archive is free; no licence is stated. Caveats: the meshed distribution section is empty, the page has not been updated in years, and the larger cases are synthetic combinations of smaller ones. Simulation uses are distribution power flow, reconfiguration optimisation and restoration or resilience studies on feeders with tie switches. Related records: data-ieee-pes-distribution-test-feeders are the IEEE feeders the page links, and data-ukgds-uk-generic-distribution-system is also listed among its related links.
